Heading: Simple pricing that follows the work
Intro: You pay for what's active, not for everyone you've ever added. Sites are free to record, and a dispersed scheme counts as a single site.
Clarifiers: An active operative is someone assigned to live work in the billing period — not your whole history.
An active site is a site with live work in the billing period.
A 10% buffer absorbs short overages before anything changes — you won't be caught out by a busy week.
Recording a site costs nothing; you're only billed on active work.

TrustNotes.Claim: Sites are free to record — you're never charged just for adding one.
A dispersed or retrofit scheme counts as one site, not many.

MetaDescription: Tedwren pricing: pay per active operative or active site, with sites free to record and a dispersed scheme counted as one site. Clear bands, no surprises.
